purpose: qualify the already-frozen model-specific chi_bio factor and the complete local Chi_bio modal precursor by testing convergence of native nonlinear NF-kB dynamics to their frozen local linear/modal predictions

horizon.pair_lane: two periods of the frozen positive-imaginary complex pole: 4*pi/|Im(lambda)|
horizon.full_modal_lane: same horizon as pair lane for within-case comparability

pair_lane.mode: unique positive-imaginary member of the already-frozen conjugate pair
pair_lane.phase_rule: rotate eigenvector by exp(-i*arg(C*v)) so the publication-native free nuclear NF-kB projection is real and maximized at t=0; this fixes eigenvector phase only and does not select a different mode
pair_lane.initial_direction: normalized real part of the phase-fixed eigenvector
pair_lane.metric: relative L2 error between nonlinear observable displacement and pair-based linear prediction
pair_lane.primary_pass_rule: relative error at 1e-4 equilibrium-norm fraction must be lower than at 1e-3; both must be finite
pair_lane.sensitivity: 1e-5 reported but not used to overturn a primary pass or failure

full_modal_lane.initial_direction: normalized all-ones six-state vector; fixed before result
full_modal_lane.linear_prediction: expm(J*t)*delta_x0 using the complete six-state Jacobian
full_modal_lane.metric: relative Frobenius/L2 trajectory error across all states
full_modal_lane.primary_pass_rule: relative error at 1e-4 equilibrium-norm fraction must be lower than at 1e-3; both must be finite
full_modal_lane.sensitivity: 1e-5 reported but not used to overturn a primary pass or failure

implementation_self_check.pair_vs_full_linear: for pair-subspace initial condition, pair analytic prediction and expm(J*t) prediction must agree to relative error <= 1e-8
implementation_self_check.real_pole_refusal: the least-negative real eigenvalue is passed to the scalar constructor as a single real pole and must return REFUSE_SINGLE_REAL_POLE

next_if_pass: adjudicate model-specific Chi_bio modal admission and then open the Bio Chi joint local-vs-realized-behavior gate
next_if_fail: preserve chi_bio algebraic P0-Q result but narrow or refuse the affected dynamical/modal interpretation
